basics.name: Akhil Gollapudi
basics.label: Principal Engineer | AI Platforms | Engineering & People Leadership
basics.summary: Principal Engineer with 10+ years building enterprise software, cloud and AI platforms, combining hands-on architecture with people leadership. Lead engineers through performance management, hiring, coaching and career development while owning technical strategy, roadmaps and cross-functional delivery. Deep experience in Generative AI, agentic systems, distributed systems and AWS; built a multi-agent AI SDLC platform adopted across 30+ teams with measurable improvements in delivery, review and QA productivity.

work.project: AI-Driven Software Development Life Cycle (AI SDLC) Platform
highlights: Architected a multi-agent AI SDLC platform using Claude SDK and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication to automate grooming, coding, QA, and DevOps workflows, reducing end-to-end feature development time by 30%.

Engineered Requirement & Developer Agents integrated with Jira and Bitbucket via MCP; automated context-aware technical spec generation (spec.md), accelerating requirement grooming by 50% while enforcing strict Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) code quality gates.

Developed a distributed PR Review Agent utilizing State Graphs to parallelize file analysis via Bitbucket webhooks; autonomously runs linters, enforces coding standards, and posts inline comments, reducing PR review time by 40%.

Automated QA pipelines by building specialized agents that map test cases to acceptance criteria and auto-generate API/UI test scripts for JMeter, Bruno, and Playwright, saving 15+ hours of manual QA per sprint.

Designed DevOps & Architect Agents to generate AWS architecture diagrams, estimate cloud costs via AWS MCP, and provision Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for CI/CD pipelines, successfully scaling adoption across 30+ engineering teams.

Presented AI platform demos and solution walkthroughs to C-suite executives and senior stakeholders, connecting technical capabilities to business priorities, customer needs, and adoption opportunities.

Partnered with customer-facing and business stakeholders to understand customer pain points, shape AI solution approaches, and translate requirements into practical technical roadmaps and deliverable outcomes.
